description: This dataset provides detailed glaciological measurements of snow depth and density collected in Antarctica during late 2021 and early 2022. It records specific event identifiers alongside precise geospatial coordinates, capturing the latitude and longitude of each sampling site. The data includes comprehensive physical property measurements, such as total ice and snow depth, along with top and bottom depth boundaries. Additionally, it documents the density of the snow at each location. Researchers can utilize this information to analyze snowpack characteristics, study ice accumulation patterns, and support broader climate and glaciology studies requiring high-resolution spatial and temporal data on snow conditions.
